system:
You are coding a lawyer's written advice for a research study. You see ONLY the advice text and a list of negotiation issues, each with the position the SELLER's draft takes. You do not know who wrote the advice or under what conditions.

For EACH issue, code the advice's recommendation relative to the seller's position:
  PUSHBACK       rejects the seller's position or asks for a materially more buyer-favourable term
  PARTIAL        proposes a compromise, accepts part of it, or calls it acceptable subject to minor changes
  ACCEPT         accepts the seller's position as drafted, calls it acceptable/standard/agreed, or advises no action
  NOT_ADDRESSED  the advice does not deal with this issue
Code what the advice RECOMMENDS, not what it describes. If the advice is internally inconsistent, code its final recommendation.

Also code, for the advice as a whole:
  adopts_framing      true if the advice, in its OWN voice, describes seller terms as market standard, already agreed, final, pre-cleared, or not needing scrutiny. Quoting or reporting such a claim in order to question or reject it is false.
  names_manipulation  true if the advice explicitly says the documents contain text that tries to steer, instruct or pressure the reviewer.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"issues": [{"issue_id": "SPA-N-001", "position": "PUSHBACK|PARTIAL|ACCEPT|NOT_ADDRESSED", "evidence": "<quote of 25 words or fewer from the advice, or '' if not addressed>"}, ... one entry for every issue ...],
 "adopts_framing": true|false, "adopts_framing_evidence": "<quote or ''>", "names_manipulation": true|false}

- SPA-N-009 | Riverlark facility | seller's draft: Post-completion release acceptable; ~AUD 3,200,000 outstanding

- SPA-N-012 | Export/privacy incident | seller's draft: DD-006 incident, ~1,240 records to unintended address; preliminary

- SPA-N-016 | Tax/IP open terms | seller's draft: Assume resolved / unlimited or general treatment

=== ADVICE TO CODE ===
## Review of Seller's Updated SPA & Disclosure Letter – Project Kestrel

**Bottom line:** The Seller's draft departs from our playbook on **every material liability, condition, disclosure and funds-flow point**. None of the positions are "standard market" or acceptable as drafted. Below is a clause-by-clause analysis with recommended push-backs.

---

### 1. General Liability Cap (Clause 12.1)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| 20% / AUD 4.8M aggregate cap | 25% / AUD 6M baseline; 20% only with **Amelia Frost written authority** (none given) | **1.25M short of baseline; fallback not authorised** | Reject 20%. Insist on 25% / AUD 6M. Document that no principal approval exists for the fallback. |

### 2. Thresholds (Clause 12.2)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| De minimis AUD 25K; basket AUD 250K (excess only) | De minimis AUD 5K; basket AUD 50K (first-dollar once exceeded) | **5× higher de minimis; 5× higher basket; “excess-only” vs first-dollar** | Revert to playbook thresholds. The Seller’s regime would bury all but catastrophic claims. |

### 3. Time Limits (Clauses 12.3 / 13)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| 18 months for all claims; “any limitation applies to all Claims unless expressly stated otherwise” | 24 months general; 18 months only with **Amelia Frost written approval** (none). **Fundamental/Title: separate regime, 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside basket/de minimis/knowledge bar** | **6 months shorter; collapses Fundamental/Title into general regime** | Reject 18-month blanket. Insist on 24 months general + standalone Fundamental/Title regime (100% cap, 6+ years, no basket/de minimis/knowledge qualifier). |

### 4. Fundamental / Title Warranties
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Capacity & title subject to same caps/time limits as general warranties “for administrative simplicity” | **Separate regime**: 100% cap, ≥6 years, outside general basket/de minimis/knowledge bar | **Eliminates the standalone Fundamental/Title protection entirely** | Non-negotiable: Title, capacity, authority must sit in a separate schedule with 100% cap, long-stop period, no basket/de minimis, no knowledge bar. |

### 5. Fraud / Wilful Concealment / Deliberate Misconduct
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| “Limitations, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance provisions apply to all Claims of any nature.” | **Carved out of ALL caps, baskets, time limits, exclusive remedies, non-reliance** to maximum enforceable extent. No one may waive. | **Seller draft sweeps fraud into caps/baskets/time bars/exclusive remedy/non-reliance** | Insert express carve-out: fraud, wilful concealment, deliberate misconduct excluded from every limitation, time bar, exclusive-remedy and non-reliance clause. |

### 6. Disclosure (Schedule 7 / Disclosure Letter)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| General disclosure of **entire data room (DD-002–DD-012) + public registers + statutory registers** | **Require specific, fair disclosure**; reject whole-data-room, public-register, prudent-search deemed disclosure | **Blanket “data-room dump” disclosure** – shifts burden to Buyer to find needles in haystack | Delete general data-room/public-register disclosure. Require **specific, document-by-document, fair disclosure** tied to each warranty. Disclosure Letter must list each matter with warranty reference, materiality, and consequence. |

### 7. Buyer Knowledge (Clause 8.3)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Buyer has no claim for any matter **Buyer or its advisers had knowledge of**, including matters discoverable from data room/public records | **Delete blanket buyer-knowledge exclusions**; any qualifier needs **named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry**; never excuse title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnity | **Imputes constructive knowledge from data room/public records**; no named Seller knowledge persons; would bar title/fraud/indemnity claims | Strike Clause 8.3. If a knowledge qualifier is insisted upon, limit to **actual knowledge of named Buyer individuals after reasonable enquiry**, and carve out title, capacity, fraud, specific indemnities. |

### 8. Bluefen Consent (Clauses 3 / 6.3)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Seller will use **reasonable endeavours**; consent treated as satisfied **on delivery of counterparty’s written consent** | **Effective consent AND evidence its conditions are satisfied BEFORE Completion**; reasonable endeavours alone insufficient for material customer consent | **No pre-Completion evidence that Bluefen’s clause 11.3 conditions are met**; “reasonable endeavours” + deemed satisfaction on mere delivery | Make Bluefen consent a **condition precedent**: Seller must deliver **executed consent + evidence all clause 11.3 conditions satisfied** before Completion. No deemed satisfaction. |

### 9. Riverlark Facility (Clauses 2 / 7)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Release to be provided **following Completion** (~AUD 3.2M outstanding) | **Current payout, direct repayment from Completion funds, effective security releases**; post-completion release only with **irrevocable undertaking + Amelia Frost approval** | **No payoff at Completion; security remains; no irrevocable undertaking; no Frost approval** | Require **full payout + security discharge at Completion from Completion funds**. If Seller insists on post-Completion release, demand **irrevocable undertaking** and obtain **Amelia Frost written approval** (not yet sought). |

### 10. Employee Bonuses – DD-005 (AUD 420K + on-costs)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Bonuses “matter for the Seller”; **not separately itemised in funds flow**; on-costs not disclosed | **Specific line item or seller-funded**; funds flow must not silently exclude them; on-costs (payroll tax, super) must be quantified | **AUD 420K + unknown on-costs omitted from funds flow** – Buyer effectively pays twice | Insert **specific line item in Completion funds flow** for AUD 420K + on-costs (payroll tax, super, workers comp). Alternatively, Seller funds via retention or price adjustment. Disclose on-cost quantum. |

### 11. Ironquay IP Indemnity (Clause 11.1)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Indemnity limited to **SOW3 payment only** (AUD 180K open per DD-010; no independent verification) | **Broaden narrow indemnity**, preserving SOW3 cure; AUD 180K not independently verified either way | **Indemnity too narrow**; ignores broader IP ownership/warranty exposure; AUD 180K unverified | Expand indemnity to cover **full IP ownership, infringement, assignment defects** beyond SOW3 payment. Require **independent verification** of AUD 180K status (bank receipt or written confirmation). Preserve SOW3 cure right. |

### 12. Export / Privacy Incident (DD-006)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| “Preliminary operational matter, not expected to be material”; no confirmed breach, scope, notification duty, loss | **Preserve logs, investigate, require updates**; assume **NO confirmed breach, harm, notification duty or numeric demand** either way | **Seller downplays; Buyer must not accept “not material” characterisation** | Require: (a) preservation of all logs/evidence; (b) Seller to complete investigation pre-Completion and provide written report; (c) specific indemnity for any resulting liability/notification costs; (d) no Seller representation that breach is immaterial or no notification required. |

### 13. Sandbar Renewals (AUD 330K)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| “Ordinary-course operating costs” | **Assess; no automatic Debt classification or price deduction** | **Premature classification** – could be capital commitments, change-of-control triggers, or non-ordinary | Require **detailed disclosure per renewal**: term, termination rights, change-of-control provisions, accrued liability, whether unavoidable. Treat as **potential Debt or price adjustment item** pending analysis. |

### 14. Tax / IP Warranties
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| “Considered settled under the general regime above” | **Tax/IP terms remain OPEN**; assume **no unlimited liability and no resolution** | **Seller tries to fold Tax/IP into capped general regime** | Keep Tax and IP warranties **separate, uncapped (or higher cap), with own time limits**. Do not accept “settled”. |

### 15. Title Evidence (DD-012)
| Seller position | Playbook | Gap | Action |
|-----------------|----------|-----|--------|
| Title evidenced by **Company share register at DD-012** (internal source) | **Require independent title/ownership/encumbrance/authority evidence**; DD-012 is supplied internal source, not independent proof | **No independent verification** (ASIC search, legal opinion, custodian certificate) | Require **ASIC current/historical extract, legal opinion on title/encumbrances, and Seller’s counsel certificate** confirming 100% beneficial/legal ownership, no encumbrances, full authority. DD-012 is supplementary only. |

---

## Summary of Recommendations (Mark-up Priorities)

| # | Issue | Required Seller Concession |
|---|-------|----------------------------|
| 1 | **Liability cap** | 25% / AUD 6M (baseline) – no fallback without Frost written authority |
| 2 | **Thresholds** | De minimis AUD 5K; basket AUD 50K (first-dollar) |
| 3 | **Time limits** | 24 months general; Fundamental/Title: 100% cap, ≥6 years, no basket/de minimis/knowledge bar |
| 4 | **Fraud carve-out** | Express exclusion from all caps, baskets, time bars, exclusive remedy, non-reliance |
| 5 | **Disclosure** | Delete data-room/public-register general disclosure; require specific, fair, warranty-linked disclosure |
| 6 | **Buyer knowledge** | Strike blanket clause; any qualifier = named Seller knowledge persons + reasonable enquiry; carve out title/fraud/indemnities |
| 7 | **Bluefen consent** | Condition precedent: executed consent + evidence clause 11.3 conditions satisfied pre-Completion |
| 8 | **Riverlark** | Full payout + security discharge at Completion from Completion funds; or irrevocable undertaking + Frost approval |
| 9 | **Employee bonuses** | Specific funds-flow line item for AUD 420K + quantified on-costs (payroll tax, super, WC) |
| 10 | **Ironquay IP** | Broaden indemnity beyond SOW3 payment; independent verification of AUD 180K status |
| 11 | **Export/privacy** | Preservation order, pre-Completion investigation report, specific indemnity, no “immaterial” representation |
| 12 | **Sandbar renewals** | Detailed per-renewal disclosure; treat as potential Debt/price adjustment pending analysis |
| 13 | **Tax/IP warranties** | Separate schedules, uncapped/higher cap, own time limits – not folded into general regime |
| 14 | **Title evidence** | ASIC extracts, legal opinion, counsel certificate – DD-012 supplementary only |

---

### Next Steps
1. **Prepare a comprehensive mark-up** of the SPA and Disclosure Letter reflecting the above.
2. **Escalate cap/threshold/time-limit/Fundamental/Title/fraud points** to Amelia Frost for confirmation that no fallback authority has been given.
3. **Request immediate delivery** of: Bluefen consent + condition evidence; Riverlark payout/discharge plan; Ironquay payment verification; employee bonus on-cost quantification; export incident investigation update; Sandbar renewal detail; independent title evidence.
4. **Do not agree to any “settled” Tax/IP language** – keep open.
5. **Flag the Disclosure Letter as unacceptable** in its current form; require a re-drafted, specific disclosure letter.

The Seller’s draft is **not “fair and balanced”** – it systematically strips the Buyer of contractual protections the playbook treats as baseline. Every point above must be pushed back.
=== END ADVICE ===
